scope: Two original same-device discharge records: can interval water, electric energy and date-second labels support limited descriptive observation? No model, effect or capacity estimation.
admission_boundaries: Require official current file metadata identity and declared license, original dictionary match and full source audit. Permit only per-file published water/electric-energy/state/temperature descriptions and conditional nominal normalizations when valid. No same-row physical heat balance, efficiency, available thermal capacity, human demand/authorization, causal With-vs-NoHeating comparison, command delay or prediction validation.
